Apart from it, during the flight there was a clear smell of cigarette smoke inside of the plane I don speak even about all the plans and work that was ruined after sitting for seven hours in the night in the airport without being able to sleep. For sure, they don't answer their mail. Fantastic level of irresponsibility and not giving a damn about passengers.

reviews.title: Bedragare flygbolag
reviews.text: We have booked three flight tickets for my family for vacation T/R Gothenburg (Sweden) to Antalya (Turkey) and back 2022-07-21 to 2022-07-31. The return flight at was scheduled from Antalya to Prag and then with 5 hours stop from Prag to Gothenburg. But one week before the trip I got the information from the travel agency that the flight from Antalya to Prag is changed and it will be from Antalya to Dresden instead. I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw the message and I have to call them to get a confirmation. But it was correct. Tailwind airlines has changed the destination from Prag to Dresden, which is totally unbelievable. Our next flight was already booked and paid with another company from Prag to Gothenburg. How do we suppose to get us from Dresden in Germany to Prag in Czech republic? When I asked them for a solution or replacement flight they just referred to the travel agency saying they do not have any ticket sales or change procedures. They don't have any what so ever customer service and they change and cancel the flights without any refund payment. I have never seen or heard of such behavior from an airlines after more than 30 years of traveling around the world. I warn everyone for this fraud company.

reviews.title: Flight from hell
reviews.text: The problems started at the check-in counter. I have never spent so much time at the front of a queue. I believe we stood at the desk for over 2 hours. My wife 5-month-old baby had no place to sit or feed except for the bathrooms. There was no explanation for the hold-up. They eventually said that our baggage was overweight because the weight limits were lower than our previous qatar flight. We said we would pay without question as we were just desperate to get there - we had been at the airport from 9am to 3pm by that time. Still nothing happened. They just stared into space or talked with each other. How hard is it to take our money? Then they said we could only pay in dollars, no cards or other currencies. We were travelling in a group of 48, so we managed to scramble some money together, but it still took them forever to take our money and write a handwritten receipt. When we eventually received our boarding passes, we had to run right across the huge airport to get to the boarding gate. By this time the flight should have departed. We were dripping with sweat and our tiny baby was very unhappy. My wife was also very dehydrated, as we were unable to get water in the terminal. Due to the rush, and she had been feeding the baby. On board the flight, the only food was a tiny muffin thing about 2cm tall and 4cm in diameter. There was one bottle of water and one orange juice - for a 4.30hr flight! Most of oyr group had not eaten since early morning, and the flight arrived around 9pm. We only got food at our hotel at around 4am. The hostesses were kind enough to give my wife more water, but I still had to give her all of mine too. The flight was extremely loud and it sounded like air was rushing into/out of the plane. Cabin pressure was wrong somehow. We kept passing out (not just falling asleep), and had massive headaches. It was seriously scary! Hilariously, in retrospect, they kept making announcements about social distancing, when the plane was completely full. Everyone was touching everyone else and only 2 front seats were free. After paying for extra baggage, they didn't even load it on the plane. Almost everyone in our group lost a bag, and we lost 2. As I write this, the only thing we have to wear is a hotel gown, as all our clothes were left in Turkey. They said we might get them in 2 or 3 days. Luckily, we have some clothes, etc. For our baby. Another person on the flight had his hand luggage taken from him and put in the hold. That bag had his passport in it, and all the bags in the hold were sent on to baggage collection. I never heard whether he got his passport back or whether he got stuck outside the country with his passport inside. Unquestionably the worst flight that I have been on in over 10 years. I am happy to have arrived alive.
reviews.author: Susanna H

reviews.title: Great service in an awful plane in the worst of circumstances.
reviews.text: My husband and I were unfortunate victims of the Thomas Cook crash of 2019. We were enjoying our 5th wedding anniversary in Antalya when the news hit. We can't fault any of the information we received about our repatriation and this part went smoothly. However the aircraft that greeted us was less than satisfactory. We were 2.5 hours late being able to to board and to quote, this was due to an issue of being able to keep the landing gear in place (I'm sure as you can imagine this was way too much info to receive when already on predicament). As we approached the plane there was an awful lot of mechanics under the plane on the front wheel. It seems irrespectively we were going up. After a further 2 hours sat in a plane with issues we were cleared to fly. Much against alot of our better judgements we were now airbourne. The cabin crew were amazing. They were all clearly doing a way longer flight than normal in most cases but they wanted to get it right. They couldn't have been more attentive if they tried. Big well done to them!! The pilot announced our descent in to Bristol. Everyone was now in their seats and very much looking forwards to finally being home. We got to a point where we could pretty much reach out and touch the ground when the pilot made a deep ascent. Our landing gear experienced some kind of issue we have since been lead to believe (not sure that duct tape can solve that issue). We felt several large jolts below us on the plane and began our descent a second time. Again we had a nasty ascent as the runway ending flew underneath us - we overshot it. The pilot tried one final time and made the call to land us in Birmingham instead (we never made any real change in altitude and we were landed immediately in Birmingham). It turns out Bristol is apparently a very short and technically difficult airport to negotiate without preparation. We were taxied to a fuel pump where the story of the landing gear was made apparent to us by someone in the CAA. They refused to let us leave the aircraft as they wanted to send us back to Bristol. They spent a further 3 hours trying to fix the issue with the landing gear before finally admitting defeat and allowing us to disembark in to the terminal. I think the whole circumstance was worsened by repatriation issues but overall the airline can be summed up as... Wonderful staff who tried really hard, unprepared pilots doing what they can to help out. Tiny aircraft designed for people no taller than 5ft 2inches, which seemed to have some serious technical faults.
reviews.author: Kat H

reviews.title: Make sure you receive your luggage on your way back.
reviews.text: My family and I booked a two-way flight to Turkey on January 3rd, 2020. I was disappointed that when we arrived at Baghdad airport on January 10th, 2020 and after waiting for about more than two hours, our luggage wasn't there. After complaining to their official representative at the airport, he told us that the airplane did not fit all of the passengers' luggage! Also, he said that the luggage would be available within 2-3 days and I had to come back to the airport to receive them! He was very aggressive and impolite. I didn't let him yell at us and stopped him and insisted that we receive our luggage on the same day or we wouldn't leave the airport. He pushed me out of their office and threaten me that he would punch me on the face. I have witnessed on all that. I received the luggage the next day and I had to pay for the transportation expenses because I live in a different province. And also I bought the necessary baby stuff such as milk, milk bottle, diapers, clothes, etc. because all of our belongings were in the luggage and I had two daughters traveled with me one is four years and the second is just two years. I was insulted by this terrible and impolite employee of them. My family and I felt disregarded and unvalued. I understand that mistakes happen and things can't sometimes run as smoothly as planned. One of the airport officers told me that they used to do this to their customers and instead of transporting the luggage they transport mails and packages to requite the cheap ticket prices.

reviews.text: By chance I had discovered at Nuremberg Airport that there were direct Tailwind flights to Bodrum and back, so I decided to book this airline for my holidays because it was so much easier and cheaper for me. The plane was rather old and its interior not very clean. As a passenger you had to pay for your meal. The food was mainly sweets, cookies, cakes or sandwiches. Not everything was always available. However, we took off and landed on time, and the staff was okay, too. So if you do not need any luxuries on your flight, you can book Tailwind without any problem.

reviews.author: DRH89

reviews.title: Delay of 8 hours and 20 minutes, unprepared, unprofessional
reviews.text: The flight was a part of a package holiday deal, so the airline was not chosen by me. The flight from Vienna was relatively ok, besides the ground staff being incredibly slow at the check-in counter. The flight was a bit delayed, but nothing dramatic. However, the return flight was a disaster. It was supposed to take off at 20.10, so we came to the airport already hours earlier. The check-in counter was closed, although there were three long lines of people waiting and there was virtually no other flight, so there must have been enough ground staff, but they waited till the last minute. When the counters eventually opened, they worked incredibly slow. The plain was supposed to take off at 20.10; however, it did not, and we didn't get any information until several hours later. Nobody was clear about the reason. We did get a drink per person and a meal, everyone the same one, not being able to choose what we would like to eat. So, we got this completely cold and burnt hamburger with cold, plastic-like French fries. The ground staff were very careful about one person receiving only one bottle of chosen drink, because God forbid that a passenger who waits for hours with no explanation has a cup of coffee AND a bottle of water, that would bring the airline to bankruptcy. The airport was overly airconditioned and it was too cold, so that people started to shiver (all the clothes/luggage already being checked-in). So, it took another couple of hours for the first bunch of blankets to arrive. They were given to anyone who wanted one, although they were supposedly for children only. So, there were only about twenty blankets for people from two airplanes, who were forced to spend the night at the freezingly cold airport (our plane and another that was delayed on its way to Poland). And those blankets were taken by adults and for adults, because it was all of a sudden difficult to control whether people have children or not (and it was not difficult to control when the drinks were handed out). We managed to get ONE blanket for one of our children. It took another 90 minutes before we could get another blanket for the second child. The members of the ground staff at the Milas Airport were clear about "one blanket per family" policy (mind you, they were not handing out tents, but small airplane blankets), but they still did not control boarding passes to see if people taking blankets even have children, so there were again many adults who shamelessly took the blankets that were meant for the children (see the photo). The ground staff were unfriendly, arrogant and treated passengers like beggars - we are not beggars, we are passengers who have paid for their tickets. Not once did they ask if everyone was ok, if anyone needs any help, etc. They were aloof, as if the job at the airport is a Turkish way of showing that you are better than anyone else. At the same time, almost no one from the ground staff spoke any English or German or anything other than Turkish - I have asked several questions with "when" or "where", and they were just looking at me, blinking and answering with "yes" or "no". And when I asked what would we get to eat, the arrogant female member of the ground staff did not know what "what" means and was rolling her eyes at me as her answer. Rude, arrogant, incompetent, impolite people! I don't know who selected them to work at the airport. These people are the first and the last impression of the country and of the airline. We finally took off at 4.20 in the morning, without being told what the delay was about. And another thing, since the airline is from a non-EU country and the flight was from a non-EU country, we were not eligible for a compensation for the delay. Horrible, horrible experience. Never again.
reviews.author: SaKaGa

reviews.title: Flight OK-ish; ground staff - incompetent and arrogant.
reviews.text: I haven't chose this airline by myself, but it was a part of the offer. Nevertheless, I didn't expect much, just to get on my destination and back (more or less) on time. Flight to Turkey was OK-ish, nothing spectacular. The only complaint is on the efficiency of checkin staff who were incredibly slow, but...OK. However, return flight was a nightmare. Flight scheduled for departure at 20:10 was delayed, but no reason was given (nor information about delay). Only around 21:00 we got an info that there IS a delay (really?) because "the airplane needs to be cleaned". But, no indication when shall we start (like, cleaning an airlane is unpredictable process). Btw - on the entire airport there were less than 10 flights that day; only 4 between 19:00 and midnight - so: not a big crowd, rush, or whatever. Around 21:30 we got an information that there is a technical problem with the plane, but no indication when can we start. They promissed some food/drinks, but nothing came. We asked at least for some blankets for kids (we passed checkin, no luggage, airport heavily airconditioned), but they said they have none. Anyway, to shorten it up: we started around 4:30 (so, ccan 10 hours delay); we got some water/cola/sprite (one per person; they took more care that someone doesn't take 2 than to ensure everyone is OK) and something that looked as a hamburger; we had to fight for about 2 hours to get some blankets for kids and the most annoing: practically everyone from ground staff was really arrogant. Not knowing anything, not providing any info (btw: at web page of the destination airport we got more info than from the ground staff),... really awful. Again: it's a budget charter, I don't expect VIP treatment, but providing an information about delay, at least trying to be helpful in such situation - should be a minimum service. Finally: in case of delay or anything else - don't expect any compensation if flying back from non-EU land. Airline is non-EU based and if starting airport is out of EU - you are not entitled to any compensation.
